# Hjørring

Hjørring is a Danish municipality (kommune) identified in the AFDK program as part of "Klynge NORD" — one of the geographic health clusters participating in Denmark's national atrial fibrillation initiative [^src1]. It appears in the corpus only in a list of clusters documenting Indicator 8 (Struktureret patientuddannelse, or structured patient education) in the AFDK 2024 report [^src1]. Beyond this single mention, no further details, claims, or relationships involving Hjørring are present in the source material.

The broader chapter in which Hjørring appears documents Indicator 8 of the AFDK program (Atrieflimren i Danmark), administered by Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram. It presents evidence for structured patient education as an integrated part of atrial fibrillation treatment, drawing on European ESC guidelines and Danish national clinical guidelines, and describes the ABC Pathway model for integrated atrial fibrillation care — covering stroke prevention (A), better symptom control (B), and cardiovascular risk reduction (C). The chapter also includes a geographic overview of the Danish health clusters participating in the AFDK program, which is the context in which Hjørring is listed under Klynge NORD.
